I am analyzing what "when a memo is saved" means in this context.

The default driver is SQLite. Three candidate files handle INSERT: store/db/sqlite/memo.go, store/db/postgres/memo.go, and store/db/mysql/memo.go. The call chain begins at server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go, which routes to s.Store.CreateMemo.

The call chain continues through store/memo.go to s.driver.CreateMemo. db.NewDBDriver selects the SQLite driver by default, and its CreateMemo executes the INSERT via QueryRowContext. The Driver interface ensures only the active driver's implementation runs. I will verify the exact paths in memo_service.go and driver.go.

I am checking whether "save" might route through UpdateMemo for edits, though that would use UPDATE rather than INSERT. I am also looking for other INSERT paths, such as memo_relation when saving comments.

Identifying the concrete method that executes the SQL INSERT when a memo is saved.

The concrete method is `CreateMemo` in `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go`. It executes the INSERT via `QueryRowContext` at line 42. This is the default candidate for new memos. `UpdateMemo` was ruled out because it performs an UPDATE instead of an INSERT.

The default driver is sqlite, selected by `NewDBDriver` in `cmd/memos/main.go`. Postgres and MySQL `CreateMemo` methods were considered but ruled out. The UI save action maps to the INSERT path, not updates. `internal/profile` is being checked for the default DSN.

The analysis is complete. I am now formatting the answer.

The concrete method is `(d *DB) CreateMemo` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`. It executes the INSERT via `d.db.QueryRowContext` at line 42. The call chain is `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` → `Store.CreateMemo` → `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo`.

The determination method follows the default driver configuration. `cmd/memos/main.go` sets the default driver to "sqlite". `db.NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go` selects `sqlite.NewDB` for that default. `store.Store.CreateMemo` delegates to the driver interface. Only the sqlite implementation runs during a default install because the other two drivers are excluded.

h12.

**`(d *DB) CreateMemo`** — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`; traced the create path from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`APIV1Service.CreateMemo` → `s.Store.CreateMemo`) through `store/memo.go` (`Store.CreateMemo` → `s.driver.CreateMemo`), then confirmed the default install selects SQLite: `cmd/memos/main.go` sets `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` (line 122), `store/db/db.go` `NewDBDriver` takes the `"sqlite"` branch and returns `sqlite.NewDB`, so the SQLite `CreateMemo` runs—not the parallel `CreateMemo` implementations in `store/db/postgres/memo.go` or `store/db/mysql/memo.go`. The INSERT itself is built at line 41 and executed via `d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, stmt, args...)` at line 42.

Note: saving an *existing* memo goes through `UpdateMemo` (an `UPDATE`, not an `INSERT`); only new memo creation hits this INSERT path.
